items.difficulty_reason: The proof sets up the \'etale chart: a finite morphism is representable, so over a surjective \'etale chart $V \to Y$ the base change $U = V \times_Y X$ is a scheme finite over $V$, and the identity $\psi_*(\mathcal{F}|_U) = f_*\mathcal{F}|_V$ transports the question to the scheme case.
